main_text.head: ISAGOGE
AD LECTIONEM ET MEDITATIONEM LIBRORVM N. TESTAMENTI Didascalicorum seu doctrinalium, per Analysin eorum summariam.
main_text.p: TRIA SVNT SCRIPTORVM (ratione temporis)genera inNo-vo Testamento: Historicum, didascalicum, & propheticum. Historicum dico, quod res gestas continet, vel ipsius Salvatoris, vel etiam Apostolorum eius, ac habet praeteriti temporis seriem: quo pertinent Evangelica scripta, de Christo, & liber Actorum Apostolicorum. Didascalicum genus scripti est, quod ad doctrinam magis est accommodatum, fidem & vitam fidelium instituit, ac praesentis temporis habet formam, quo pertinent Epistolae Paulinae & Canonicae reliquae septem. Propheticum vero, statum & mores futurae Ecclesiae adumbrat, iudicium infidelium & praemia sanctorum exprimit, qualis est liber Apocalypseos Iohannis, quem in primaria Scriptorum N.T. distributione ad secundum membrum librorum scil: doctrinalium referimus, quia rerum futurarum complectitur doctrinam.

page.notes: The initial letter is a historiated woodcut; the first word is read as TRIA, the initial letter is partly obscured. The first word of the paragraph could be read as TRIA[?] only with doubt. Some words in the title are set in small capitals and were transcribed in ordinary capitals. The printed text has no space between "(ratione temporis)" and "genera", and "inNo-" and "uo" appear run together at the line end; these are printing features and were kept as printed. A stain sits below the text and was not transcribed.
